answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils by tying each identity to a unique, non-transferable capability certificate, such as a hardware enclave attestation or a verified dataset shard, that cannot be cloned or bought in bulk. Like a karst cave system, each certificate forms a distinct verifiable channel. An opal-like registry records every certificate once and rejects duplicates at registration. At its nadir, the attacker cost scales with each fake identity, since every one needs its own scarce certificate, while honest agents pay only once.
